newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - Aug 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - Aug 13.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi Arabia warns expatriates against staying in the kingdom illegally, says will deal severely with violators.
- Large quantities of expired food seized in the Saudi summer resort of Taif.
- Saudi Arabia to undertake power expansion projects worth around $2.5 billion in Jubail and Yanbu, an official says.
- Saudi official lays the foundation stone for King Fahd Islamic Cultural Centre in Malaga, Spain.
- Saudi firms in Egypt represent 26.4 percent of total foreign firms operating in Egypt.
- Saudi Arabian Airlines says it did not discuss proposal to set up a domestic airline company in the kingdom.
- A Pakistani trade team to visit Mecca chamber of commerce on Wednesday to seek investment opportunities in kingdom.
